line: Hey, I'm Shorty. The board member who never clocks out.
First, the board uploads the community rules.
Then the info that matters: contacts, links and events.
Now I'm fully trained on your community. Ask me anything, 24/7.
Eleven at night. The office is closed.
Sally's up late with her new puppy.
She wonders about a fence for the backyard.
So she asks Shorty.
Zone 2. Black aluminum fence, 54 inches max.
A neighbor owns a fence company. Want me to reach out?
She says yes.
Done. Free estimate booked for tomorrow.
Sally and the pup call it a night. Shorty doesn't.
This is Betty. She's 70, and she lives for bingo.
But she never opens the management emails.
And she skips the gym, where the bulletin board is.
So she never sees what's going on.
Now it all lands on her phone.
Bingo night. 15 spots left.
One tap, and she's in.
Betty's happy. Bingo is saved.
Meanwhile, Shorty runs the office.
He sends the weekly newsletter.
Burn ban today? One text goes to every resident.
He reads every resident report.
There's a food truck parked outside the clubhouse. Shorty orders lunch.
He walks out, and it's already paid for.
Hot food, no waiting. Shorty never clocks out.
And Sally and Betty aren't the only ones.
Every resident can do this. If a business is on the Shortlist, it's one tap in the app.
It's not just about communicating. It's about a great place to live.
Shorty and the Shortlist make that happen.
